big: There was a gap in the middle. Ordinary mutual funds on one side. PMS and AIFs on the other. From 1 April 2025, SEBI added Specialised Investment Funds, SIFs, in between.

lines: It is run by a mutual fund house, with a minimum of ₹10 lakh per investor, counted across the fund house's SIF strategies. SIFs may use strategies ordinary funds cannot, such as limited short exposure through derivatives, called long-short. Strategy names, limits and rules are set by SEBI, so read the scheme document carefully.
